metadata.description: The Microstock+ plugin for Claude: manage a stock contributor's portfolio, metadata, CSV exports and agency uploads.

plugins.name: microstock-plus
plugins.description: Manage your Microstock+ stock portfolio from Claude: audit and improve titles, descriptions, keywords and categories, preview and apply batch edits without overwriting newer ones, check statuses and rejections, and export CSV. Queueing uploads and AI keywording are coming later. Nothing can be deleted through it.
